verdict.rationale: Jira documents its own automation rules, including custom automations that range "from automated reminders to rules that move work forward," and automation that "keeps Jira up to date." Reminders suggest time-based triggering, but no evidence explicitly documents a scheduled or recurring trigger, as opposed to one-off, event-driven rules. missing for 10: explicit scheduled/cron-style trigger documentation, recurring-event trigger details, documentation of how rules handle routine team work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
